title: Remobilization Fee Carried by a Past-Due Reconstruction Draw Payment
content:
The remobilization a payment that brings a past-due customer-funded draw of a Reconstruction contract current carries follows the suspension of work.

**Rule.**

- While work on the contract is suspended with no resumption dated on or after the suspension, the payment carries the tier's remobilization fee, booked when work resumes.
- When work resumed within the past month after a suspension without any draw payment posted on the contract on or after the suspension date, so that no payment carried its fee, and the remobilization line for that resumption is booked, the payment carries that line.
- Otherwise it carries no remobilization.

**The past month.** Counting back one month from the payment date, a date is within the past month when it falls after the same day of the month in the previous calendar month and on or before the payment date; when the previous calendar month has no such day, every date in that previous month is outside the past month.

## The tier's remobilization fee

| Agreement | Remobilization fee |
|---|---|
| Repair Agreement - Minor Repairs | $150.00 |
| Standard Rebuild Agreement | $325.00 |
| Major Rebuild Agreement | $475.00 |
| Full Structural Rebuild Agreement | $650.00 |
| Multifamily Unit Rebuild Agreement | $325.00 |
| Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement | $850.00 |

## Cases

| Contract record at the payment date | Carried |
|---|---|
| suspension date recorded, no resumption on or after it | the tier's remobilization fee |
| work resumed within the past month after a suspension, no draw payment posted on the contract on or after the suspension date, remobilization line booked | that remobilization line |
| work resumed within the past month, but a draw payment was posted on or after the suspension date | none |
| never suspended, or resumed before the past month | none |

**Example (hypothetical).** On a Major Rebuild Agreement whose work is suspended with no resumption recorded, the payment carries $475.00.
